name: Anthropic Work Token
description: Bind-mounts the host ~/.anthropic-work-key file into the container and installs it at $HOME/.anthropic-work-key (mode 600) at postCreate time. Paired with dotfiles that export CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from that file. Mount target is under /var to avoid being shadowed by /tmp tmpfs overlays (e.g., from docker-in-docker).
